spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (व्रीयते) r. 9th cl. (व्रीणाति or व्रीणीते)
1 To choose or elect.
2 To cover or screen.

r. 4th cl. (व्रीडयति)
1 To be modest, to be bashful or ashamed.
2 To throw, to direct or send.

mf. (-डः-डा)
Shame, bashfulness.
E.
व्रीड to be ashamed, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-नं)
Bashfulness, modesty.
E.
व्रीड to be ashamed, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ashamed, hanging down the head with shame.
E.
व्रीडा, and आनत bowed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Modest.
E.
व्रीडा, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ashamed, modest.
E.
व्रीड to be ashamed, क्त aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रीसति व्रीसयति)
To hurt or injure, to kill or wound.

m. (-हिः)
1 Rice of various kinds: eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities, but the varieties are more numerous.
2 Rice ripening in the rainy season.
E.
व्री to choose. हि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having rice, bearing rice, &c.
E.
व्रीहि rice, and ठन् aff.

m. (-नः)
A sort of pulse, (Ervum lens or hirsutum, &c.)

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Having rice, (a field, &c.)
E.
व्रीहि rice, इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum.)
E.
व्रीहि rice, and भेद sort.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made or consisting of rice.
m. (-यः)
A rice cake offered with ghee as an oblation.
E.
व्रीहि rice, and मयट् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Panic seed, (Panicum italicum.)
2 Another species, (Panicum miliaceum.)
E.
व्रीहि rice, राजिक shining, excelling.

n. (-रं)
A granary, a shed where rice or other grain is stored.
E.
व्रीहि rice, अगार a house.
